shared_elements: repeated linear incised or carved motifs
justification: Both surfaces show schematic, non-figural ornament organised by straight framing lines, and both use repeated linear elements, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A depicts a dense row of identical vertically ribbed, tasselled pendant forms hanging in high relief from a horizontal band, whereas B shows a single large lightly incised rectilinear frame with nested borders and a small looped motif at the centre, an entirely different composition and depth of carving.
